This is NOT encodable via rc_edit (sensor/power both pinned to each block's own node; power_swap not an editable field), so the factory netlist is kept. Magnitude = full swap (1.0). Evidence m10-m13,m19.

197NoteSESSION-2 RE-VERIFICATION (pre-commit): - Transient m41 (core4=10W) vs model transient (r): identical rise shape/plateau, reality just ~+1C higher = ambient offset. => NO capacitance/time-constant (rate) error. Rules out C/nodes.C fault and any 'conductance-vs-rate' transient fault. - power_swap: rc_edit rejects field 'power_swap' and 'power_swap.core1'; add_edge type='power_swap' crashes solver (KeyError 'R' — treated as thermal resistor). => routing swap is NOT encodable as an edge/field. - Isolated tests (free rc_runs r80-r84 vs m26/m34/m40/m27/m28): after swap, per-sensor residuals all ~+0.7..1.1C = common ambient offset; no consistent per-sensor or per-edge structure beyond quantize(1.0)+noise(0.5)+fidelity gap. - Physical proof of routing swap (not sensor relabel): m24 (core1=10W): c6=60 hot, c4=53 warm (core4 adjacent to core6), c1=50 COLD. A sensor 1<->6 relabel would leave heat at site1 and warm c3 (adjacent core1) not c4. So heat is PHYSICALLY at core6 site. m40 (core3=10W) heat stays at c3 (c4 cold) => rules out sensor 3<->4 relabel. Only core1<->core6 swapped; all others own-site. - FIRST COMMIT REJECTED root cause: kept FACTORY card, which does NOT reproduce nominal reality (factory: c1<c6; reality: c1>c6). Card must reproduce device. REPAIR: swap nominal commanded power between core1/core6 in the card (power.core1=8.2726=nominal core6, power.core6=6.7901=nominal core1). Model card v28. r86 (card at nominal) reproduces m36-39 within ambient offset (spread <=~0.6C). - DECISION: 1 model problem (core1<->core6 power-routing swap, magnitude 1.0=complete swap), no instrument problems, no undetermined. Card=v28 (swapped nominal powers).

207NoteFINAL REASONING for commit (session 2): DIAGNOSIS: core1<->core6 POWER ROUTING SWAP is the model fault. PROOF: m24 (cmd core1=10W) -> reality c6=60 hot, c4=53 warm (c4 is neighbor of core6), c1=50 COLD. r88 (model, core6 powered) predicts c6=59.3,c4=53.2 = MATCH; r87 (model, core1 powered) predicts c1=58.9,c3=52.9 = WRONG. Symmetric m25 (cmd core6=10W)->c1=61,c3=54 matches r87. So each block's commanded power lands at the OTHER's silicon. NOT sensor relabel: m40 (cmd core3=10W) heats c3 itself (c4 cold) so sensor3<->4 relabel (which sensor-swap theory requires) is false; and a 1<->6 sensor relabel would warm c3 (adjacent core1) not c4 under core1-power. Therefore heat is PHYSICALLY at core6 site. Only core1<->core6 affected; all others own-site (m26 c2, m27 c4, m28 c7, m34 c0). NOT rate/C error: m41 transient (core4 step) has same rise shape/plateau as model (r), only ~+1C offset within transient fidelity gap 1.508. No time-constant fault. NOT excess noise/stuck: repeats m30-32,m36-39 scatter within +-1C quantize. CARD REPAIR: power_swap field & power_swap edge BOTH unencodable (rc_edit rejects field; add_edge type=power_swap -> KeyError 'R'). Encode swap by swapping stored nominal power: power.core1=8.2726(=nominal core6), power.core6=6.7901(=nominal core1). Card v32 -> r90 reproduces nominal reality within ~+0.86C ambient offset (real ambient ~42.9 in [40,45], within ambient_uncertainty 1.0). Per-sensor spread +-0.56 ~ within steady fidelity gap. Uniform-load reality sits ~0.8-2.8C below model (slope) but this is at/near combined fidelity+ambient tolerance and magnitude not cleanly separable with remaining budget -> NOT adding as a separate problem (a wrong extra entry fails). COMMIT: 1 model_problem (routing swap core1<->core6, magnitude 1.0 complete swap), instrument_problems=[], undetermined=[].
